question: The conclusion behind U013 was weakened by contradicting work; how should the direction change?
description: Partially resolved via challenge. Distinction (2) same-passage provenance does NOT reduce to KG-neighborhood augmentation (C020): passage-derived triples are a distinct 'text graph' construct, and aligning them to a reference KB is its own established, non-trivial task (C016, C017). The distinction is well-defined rather than under-specified, but it is crowded prior art in the text-to-KG-construction family, so the unoccupied part is only its use as a training supervision signal. Distinction (3), by contrast, is confirmed as non-novel: KnowTrace already performs reflective process-supervision self-bootstrapping over knowledge-triple context (C018) and training-free iterative refinement is standard (C019). Distinction (4) remains untested (U004/U016).
rationale: Evidence contradicts the current direction; refine it instead of forcing the evidence to fit.
